name: MEDA Workforce Development
description: Free bilingual job training, career coaching, and placement services
fullDescription: Mission Economic Development Agency (MEDA) offers a free Workforce Development Program that helps San Francisco's low- and moderate-income job seekers land living-wage jobs and grow their careers, with bilingual English/Spanish support at its Mission neighborhood center.
whatTheyOffer:
- One-on-one career coaching
- Job readiness training (resumes, interviews, job search)
- Hands-on industry skills training, including the 15-week Mission Techies IT Pre-Apprenticeship
- Financial coaching
- Job placement and retention support
- Support services such as childcare and transportation help
howToGetIt:
1. Contact MEDA's Workforce Development team or visit the Mission Resource Center
2. Fill out the interest form for the program you want and attend an orientation
3. Meet with a career coach
4. Enroll in training programs
5. Receive ongoing job search support
address: 2301 Mission St, Suite 301, San Francisco, CA 94110
keywords: MEDA, Mission District, San Francisco, job training, workforce development, career coaching, Latino, digital literacy, job placement, financial coaching
